cells.label: The Fool - barefoot wanderer mid-step off a starry cliff edge, knapsack on a stick, small dog snapping at his heels
The Magician - robed conjurer, one arm raised to the stars and one pointing to the ground, infinity halo, wand cup sword and coin floating around him
The High Priestess - veiled seer enthroned between one black and one white pillar, crescent-moon crown, scroll in lap
The Empress - crowned matron on a cushioned throne amid golden wheat, heart-shaped shield
The Emperor - armored patriarch on a ram-horned stone throne, ankh scepter
The Hierophant - triple-crowned priest with raised blessing hand, two crossed golden keys at his feet
The Lovers - man and woman standing beneath a winged sun-angel
Strength - calm woman gently closing a lion's jaws with bare hands, infinity halo
The Hermit - hooded grey elder on a peak holding up a lantern with a six-pointed star inside
Justice - enthroned figure with upraised double-edged sword and hanging scales, red robe
The Hanged Man - serene figure hanging upside-down by one ankle from a living tree beam, golden halo
Temperance - winged angel pouring glowing starlight between two cups, one foot on land one in water
The Devil - horned goat-demon squatting on a black plinth, inverted pentagram on brow, two small chained figures
The Star - kneeling maiden pouring two jugs of starwater under one huge eight-pointed gold star
The Moon - pale sorceress with a crescent face-moon staff, twin hounds howling at her feet, crayfish at the hem of her robe
The Sun - radiant laughing child rider on a white horse carrying an orange banner, sunflower crown
Judgement - stern angel blowing a long gold trumpet, small rising figures reaching up around the hem
The World - dancer wreathed in a laurel ring holding two wands, poised mid-step
